title: Steel Legs
description: Two classic blocks for legs and core: lunges, glute bridge and deep core work

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Quick lateral shuffles, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm to the sky

exercises.name: 1.5 squats
exercises.instructions: Squat down, come halfway up, go back down, stand up fully

exercises.name: Lateral lunges
exercises.instructions: Big lateral step, bend one leg, keep the other straight

exercises.name: Glute bridge march
exercises.instructions: In a bridge, alternately lift one leg then the other like marching

exercises.name: Forearm plank
exercises.instructions: On forearms, body perfectly aligned, brace the abs

exercises.name: Bicycle crunches
exercises.instructions: Elbow to opposite knee alternating, leg extended

exercises.name: Leg raises
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift straight legs vertically

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Face down, bring foot toward opposite hand by rotating

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
